info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Mortgage Loans Underwritings-v1-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loans Underwriting Listing API provides access to retrieve a comprehensive list of underwriting details associated with mortgage loans. This API enables stakeholders such as loan officers, financial analysts, and underwriters to efficiently gather underwriting information for evaluation and decision-making purposes. Users can filter and sort the results to streamline data analysis and improve operational workflows. Overall, this API supports the mortgage lending process by enhancing visibility into underwriting statuses and insights.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to access detailed information regarding the loan underwriting process, including current statuses, eligibility criteria, and any associated risks.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate the loan underwriting process. It includes the necessary parameters for evaluating the loan application, ensuring that all required information is provided in a structured format.

ListMortgageLoansUnderwritingsRequest.description: The request body for the underwriting operations GET request in the loans service. This string should contain the relevant JSON payload required for the request.

ListMortgageLoansUnderwritingsResponse_2.title: Loan Underwriting Response

status.description: Indicates the success status of the underwriting operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the loan application.

resultId.description: An identifier for the specific underwriting result.

state.description: The current state of the loan application.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the underwriting request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the underwriting operation.

audit.description: Information related to the audit of the loan underwriting operation.

ListMortgageLoansUnderwritingsResponse_2.description: This schema represents the response returned from the loan underwriting operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user who created the loan application.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the loan application was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the underwriting process was automated.

AuditInfo.description: This schema provides auditing details related to the loan underwriting operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken by the server to process the request in milliseconds.
